aaa.notAvailable: RADIUS and TACACS+ login are not built yet (F-aaa). Only local users can log in today.

tls.intro: Pick a certificate and its private key from the secret store (System › Secrets). A key that does not match, or an expired certificate, is refused when you commit. A good pair is loaded without restarting the API.
tls.noListener: The API is not serving HTTPS on this device (VRX_HTTPS_PORT is not set). The certificate is still checked and loaded, and is used as soon as the HTTPS listener is enabled.
tls.loadError: The committed certificate could not be loaded; the previous one is still in use: {{error}}
